# RK Group of Industries

> RK Group is a diversified Pakistani industrial group spanning food, edible oils, energy, chemicals, manufacturing and infrastructure. Its roots reach back to a family trading enterprise established in 1953, and it now brings together 13 operating companies.

## Brands

- [ACP Banaspati Ghee](https://rkgroupofindustries.com/brands/acp-banaspati-ghee/): banaspati ghee
- [Dilpasand Banaspati](https://rkgroupofindustries.com/brands/dilpasand-banaspati/): banaspati ghee
- [Deewan Banaspati Ghee](https://rkgroupofindustries.com/brands/deewan-banaspati/): banaspati ghee
- [Gulberg Banaspati Ghee](https://rkgroupofindustries.com/brands/gulberg-banaspati-ghee/): banaspati ghee
- [Islamabad Nimco](https://rkgroupofindustries.com/brands/islamabad-nimco/): traditional savoury snack mixes
- [Islamabad Macaroni](https://rkgroupofindustries.com/brands/islamabad-macaroni/): pasta
- [Kashmir Tea](https://rkgroupofindustries.com/brands/kashmir-tea/): tea

## Wholesale

RK Group currently sells wholesale only, to distributors, wholesalers, large retailers and commercial buyers. It does not take retail orders and does not publish prices. Payment is in cash at pickup, and buyers collect orders with their own transport from the factories in Mirpur, Azad Kashmir. Order amounts and terms: https://rkgroupofindustries.com/#distributors

Wholesale enquiries: 051-4449011 (+92 51 4449011), Monday to Saturday, 10am to 6pm.
